response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS average_ana FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_ana) AS mean_average_ana FROM patient_averages) SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, p.average_ana, p.average_ana - o.mean_average_ana AS excess FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_ana > o.mean_average_ana ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
